public.title: Top K Frequent Words
public.description: Return the k most frequent distinct words, sorted by descending count and then ascending ASCII lexicographic order for ties. words contains 1 to 500 nonempty lowercase ASCII words of length at most 30. k is 1 through the number of distinct words.
hints: Count first; sort distinct words with an explicit tie rule.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Frequency descending and ASCII word ascending define a total ordering. Sorting u distinct words uses O(u log u) comparisons.
